name: A4 factorial big int
code:
def fact(n):
    r = 1
    while n > 1:
        r *= n
        n -= 1
    return r

print(fact(20))
print(fact(25))
print(fact(30) // fact(28))

name: B5 palindrome filter
code:
def clean(s):
    out = ''
    for ch in s.lower():
        if ch.isalpha():
            out += ch
    return out
t = clean('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama!')
print(t)
print(t == t[::-1], len(t))
print(clean('No lemon, no melon'))
print(clean('123 456'))

name: D6 fibonacci generator
code:
def fibgen(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        yield a
        a, b = b, a + b
        i += 1
print(list(fibgen(10)))
print(sum(fibgen(12)))
print([v for v in fibgen(8) if v % 2 == 0])

name: D7 infinite source take
code:
def naturals():
    n = 1
    while True:
        yield n
        n += 1
g = naturals()
out = []
for _ in range(5):
    out.append(next(g))
print(out)
def take(gen, k):
    res = []
    i = 0
    while i < k:
        res.append(next(gen))
        i += 1
    return res
print(take(naturals(), 6))
print(take((x * x for x in naturals()), 4))
